Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <8uv9u9$670$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>, <theve...@my-deja.com> wrote:
>When exactly can you tap the mystic? only during your turn? any time?
>even during combat involving another one of your aliies?

Anytime, but not (as I discovered when I asked a very similar question)
in the middle of resolving an amount of damage. So, you can't save
your Garou from a Sewer Lid by tapping the mystic between resolving
damage points 2 and 3, but any other time (say, between Blurred Hand
strike 2 and 3) is fine.

>what happens when allies/retainers get thefted. do they lose life?

Yup. Note that you can only theft retainers at long range, which means
Theft of Vitae and (I think) Kraken's Kiss.

>sorry for my ignorance. i've only just discovered the joys of playing
>with allies. anyone got any memories of mortality for trade?

You can't have 'em. Dammit. Soon, my Seekrit Ninja Spies will steal
yours, adding them to my copious collection. MWAHAHA. Um. Sorry.
